note: S3a verified taxonomy overlay (schema 1). Routes gap-closers/CC/defensives/self-sustain only; never Main. Defensive tiers: minor = Yellow+, major = Red, immunity = last resort. CC stuns/silences are gated to casting/fleeing non-boss targets by the consumer. Never-automatic abilities stay Never whatever this file says. Every Auto/Suggest id is verified against spell-verification.json; an unverified id is loaded as Never with a 'needs verification' note.

entries.notes: Death Grip: gap-closer pull only when the target is confirmed out of melee and in range; never toward hazards/raid bosses.
Death Charge: Rider hero-talent gap-closer; out-of-melee + in-range only.
Death's Advance: escape/speed burst; breaks roots and kites out of danger.
Wraith Walk: emergency escape; offered, not auto-fired.
Mind Freeze: interrupt/kick only on a live enemy cast; MaxDps's own interrupt claim always wins the slot first.
Asphyxiate: single-target stun; casting/fleeing non-boss targets only.
Blinding Sleet: AoE disorient; manual (MaxDps-owned rotation stun).
Control Undead: subjugate/mind-control; never-automatic list.
Raise Ally: battle rez; never-automatic list.
Icebound Fortitude: major defensive; Red urgency only.
Anti-Magic Shell: major magic mitigation; Red.
Vampiric Blood: major defensive/heal amplification; Red.
Anti-Magic Zone: ground AoE group mitigation; manual.
Anti-Magic Barrier: minor mitigation; Yellow+.
Lichborne: minor defensive; Yellow+ (fear/incapacitate break).
Rune Tap: minor mitigation; Yellow+.
Tombstone: minor absorb; Yellow+.
Gloom Ward: minor absorb; Yellow+.
Death Strike: solo HP-ladder heal at/below 65% HP; scales with recent damage taken.
Death Pact: emergency absorb/heal consuming an undead minion; below 30% solo.
